results.title: How to Create Multilingual Surveys: A Practical Guide for Workplaces (2025)
results.content: Omnipresent AI People Scientist for instant insights and actions. # How to Create Multilingual Surveys: A Practical Guide for Workplaces (2025). You miss out on valuable feedback from much of your respondents by sticking to just one language. Research shows that 75% of consumers feel more satisfied with brands that communicate in their native language. Your surveys should be culturally sensitive and technically sound to strike a chord with people of all backgrounds. People give more accurate responses in their native language. This leads to better data quality and deeper insights. This piece will guide you through the creation, implementation, and analysis of multilingual surveys that work for your diverse workforce and customers. Organizations with diverse audiences need to understand the basics of these surveys and know the right time to use them. The main goal is to help all participants understand and answer questions accurately in their native language. Surveys in just one language tend to favor native speakers of that language.
